name: Remote MCP Server (Authless)
description: Enables deployment of Model Context Protocol servers on Cloudflare Workers without authentication requirements. Provides a template for creating custom MCP tools that can be accessed remotely via SSE endpoints and integrated with Claude Desktop or Cloudflare AI Playground.
